critic.fix_suggestion: Add two horizontal rows of small rectangular planes along the fuselage side hull. Each row should consist of 30 individual planes, spaced at a constant interval of 15cm with a width of 40cm and a height of 20cm. Position these rows symmetrically above and below the cabin centerline to replicate the continuous window line of the reference model.

discrepancies.reference: A series of distinct individual panes arranged in a wrap-around cockpit structure
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: subdivide and arrange multiple small planes

discrepancies.observed: No visible window lines along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Two long, continuous rows of small rectangular windows running the length of the cabin
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add repeated small plane geometries in two horizontal rows
